message: My dinner set (ORD-1060) still hasn't arrived and it's been more than three weeks.

evidence.sql: SELECT * FROM shop_orders.orders WHERE customer_id = 'C009' AND order_id = 'ORD-1060'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: Order ORD-1060 was placed on 2026-10-01, shows status shipped with no delivery_date, and 24 days have passed since the order date, exceeding the 14-day not_received threshold (E1). Order total is $95.00, under the $200.00 auto-approve limit; final_sale is false, already_refunded is false, and there are 0 approved refunds in the last 90 days (checks). Per R4, the customer may choose a refund (E4).

critique.reason: Every factual claim is supported by evidence (E1 for order date, shipped status, null delivery_date, $95.00 total, final_sale false; E4 for R4's 14-day threshold, $200.00 auto-approve limit, and customer choice of refund/replacement) and agrees with the Python checks (24 days since order, not delivered, total under limit, already_refunded false, 0 approved refunds in last 90 days). E2's empty refund history corroborates the refund-history claims attributed to the checks. No blocking rules apply.

customer_reply: I'm sorry your Ceramic Dinner Set (ORD-1060) hasn't arrived yet. Since it's been 24 days since your order on October 1st, you're eligible for a full refund or a replacement. Please let me know which option you'd prefer.
limitations: No delivery tracking carrier details beyond the order status were available for verification
